sources.entry: Wiki.js - Modern, lightweight and powerful wiki app using Git and Markdown. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker/K8S
Wiki.js | Modern and powerful wiki app built on Node.js

summary.one_liner: Wiki.js is an open-source, Node.js-based wiki application; this repository holds the in-development 3.0 beta, which the README says is not for production use.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Wiki.js as a "next generation" open source wiki and links to an official website, documentation, requirements, installation instructions, a changelog, and a feature request tracker. It states that this repository is a BETA of the upcoming 3.0 release and should not be used in production. The stable 2.x line is said to live in a separate repository, requarks/wiki-v2. The rest of the README is sponsor, donation, and thanks content, which is excluded here. The README gives no concrete feature list, so capabilities beyond the wiki description are taken from the awesome-list metadata only, which mentions Git and Markdown.
how_to_run: See the Requirements and Installation sections in the README or the official documentation site (links not expanded in the README text).
notable: Open source wiki app built on Node.js
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under Wikis with Git and Markdown noted
Official Docker and Kubernetes deployment options mentioned in the list metadata
Stable 2.x line maintained separately in requarks/wiki-v2
caveats: This repository is a BETA of version 3.0 and the README says it is NOT FOR PRODUCTION USE
The stable release is 2.x, kept in a separate repository
README gives no detailed feature or install instructions beyond links
